understanding: The supplied code supports a partial map of candidate orchestration, separate asynchronous election-result producers, vote persistence, and local authority setters. Pre-vote tallies consume normalized results that can include compatibility-generated grants. Election success completes a local role-field update; leader-loop initialization and known-leader publication remain unresolved. Storage calls returning successfully are distinguished from verified crash durability.

activities.purpose: Campaign for authority and update local role and term context.
activities.realization_summary: The candidate loop chooses pre-vote or direct election, consumes campaign-specific result channels, handles higher terms, and sets local role. Separate goroutines obtain remote results. Role mutation is atomic; term mutation follows a successful StableStore call.
variants: Pre-vote is bypassed when disabled or when candidacy originates from leadership transfer.
An unsupported remote pre-vote command is normalized into a granted pre-vote result.
Local self-voting occurs only when the latest configuration contains the local server as a Voter.
unknowns: The dispatch loop, leader initialization, setLeader implementation, and inbound vote handlers are not attached.
quorumSize implementation and configuration validation are not attached.
Transport selection and StableStore crash/error semantics remain unresolved.

behaviors.protocol_context: One runCandidate invocation with invocation-local result channels and counters.
legal_preconditions: Intended entry is Candidate state; the caller and dispatch loop are unread.
implementation_guards: Pre-vote runs only when enabled and the leadership-transfer flag is false.
Loop iterations require the current role to be Candidate.
Pre-vote higher-term handling compares against the term captured as currentTerm + 1 at entry.
Vote higher-term handling compares against the current term at consumption.
reads: Role, current term, campaign results, quorumSize result, election timeout, and leadership-transfer flag.
writes: Leadership-transfer flag is cleared by deferred cleanup.
durable_effects: Higher-term results invoke setCurrentTerm after setting Follower.
external_effects: After sufficient granted vote results, calls setState(Leader), then setLeader(localAddr, localID), and returns.
Processes incoming RPCs through an unread dispatcher.
Rejects configuration changes, application, verification, restore, and leadership-transfer requests with ErrNotLeader.
Returns a cloned configuration for configurationsCh requests and ErrCantBootstrap for bootstrap requests.
important_branches: A sufficient pre-vote grant tally disables the pre-vote channel, resets the timer, and starts electSelf.
A sufficient pre-vote refusal tally logs failure but continues waiting.
Higher-term results cause a Follower update followed by a term update and return.
Granted vote results increment a counter without a visible voter-ID deduplication or term-equality check.
Timeout returns without explicitly changing the role; subsequent dispatch is unread.
Shutdown returns; follower notification can replace the timeout when configuration changes.
async_boundaries: Select receives results from independent RPC goroutines.
RPC processing can affect protocol context before subsequent result consumption.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Selected client-facing operations received while campaigning complete with ErrNotLeader.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Configuration-change requests received while campaigning are rejected; configuration queries receive a clone.

existing_protections: Invocation-local channels separate campaign result streams.
The leadership-transfer flag is reset on every normal exit through the deferred cleanup.
Pre-vote success disables further consumption from that pre-vote channel.
unknowns: quorumSize calculation, legal configuration identities, RPC effects, and dispatch after return are not established.
Local Leader state does not establish completed leader-loop initialization.

identity.proposal: captured request term; returned result term can differ

facts.recovery: No recovery of these results is shown.
unknowns: The result carries no explicit compatibility-fallback provenance.
Remote approval semantics are not established.

facts.recovery: No recovery of campaign channels is shown.

surfaces.entry_point: Raft.runCandidate, electSelf, preElectSelf, and authority setters
surfaces.reason: Maps the supplied main-thread orchestration and local setter semantics. Independent workers and persistence are separated below; mapping does not establish completed leader initialization.
Independent remote vote producer with explicit transport-error normalization.
Independent pre-vote result producer, including the compatibility-generated grant branch.
Sequential store-call outcomes are mapped without claiming atomic or durable vote recovery.
The candidate calls are visible, but setLeader and role dispatch/leader initialization declarations are not attached. Local Leader publication cannot be equated with completed readiness.

delta.rationale: Expand only the selected authority frontier and its directly connected result producers and persistence helper. Facts describe producer-established operation outcomes and channel inputs, preserving the distinction between pre-vote compatibility grants, remote voting guarantees, local role publication, and completed authority initialization. Unread callees and storage semantics remain explicit gaps; no normative obligation or correctness conclusion is introduced.

limitations: All judgments are descriptive observations of the attached code, not independently validated protocol guarantees.
Inbound vote/pre-vote handlers, quorum calculation, configuration validation, transport implementations, storage variants, and startup recovery remain unread.
The attached snapshot and configuration helper code is outside this focused expansion.
No execution, calibration, reproduction, or overall correctness assessment was performed.
